# Load data

In this section, We revisit candidate genes identified from a small dataset DEA analysis. We compare their expression patterns across the original small dataset, the full dataset, and another independent small dataset

```{r}
small <- readRDS(file = "./objects/reference_analysis_small_obj.rds")
se_small <- small$se
df_small <- rowData(se_small)$DEA.interaction
df_small$staged.FDR <- rowData(se_small)[rownames(df_small),]$Interaction_staged.FDR
rownames(se_small) <- sub(".*\\.", "", rownames(se_small))

# select the candidate genes from small dataset interaction analysis
candidates <- rownames(se_small)[which(rowData(se_small)$Interaction_staged.FDR < 0.05 & rowData(se_small)$proteinCoding == TRUE)]
candidates_order <- candidates[order(rowData(se_small[candidates,])$Interaction_staged.FDR)] # order them by staged.FDR for visualization 

# load another small dataset
# generated from 04_appendix_additional_small_dataset_analysis.Rmd
small2 <- readRDS(file = "./objects/reference_analysis_small_obj_alternative.rds")
se_small2 <- small2$se
df_small2 <- rowData(se_small2)$DEA.interaction
df_small2$staged.FDR <- rowData(se_small2)[rownames(df_small2),]$Interaction_staged.FDR
rownames(se_small2) <- sub(".*\\.", "", rownames(se_small2))

# load full dataset
full <- readRDS(file = "./objects/reference_analysis_obj.rds")
se_full <- full$se
df_full <- rowData(se_full)$DEA.interaction
df_full$staged.FDR <- rowData(se_full)[rownames(df_full),]$Interaction_staged.FDR
rownames(se_full) = sub(".*\\.", "", rownames(se_full))
```

# Visualization

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 10, out.width = "100%"}
df_small$staged.FDR <- ifelse(is.na(df_small$staged.FDR), 1, df_small$staged.FDR)
show <- getrn(small$se, candidates)
fig5a_left <- volcano(df_small, logFC = logFC, signif = staged.FDR, labels = show) +
  labs(x = "Sex:Stress Interaction logFC", tag = "A") + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-10, 10))

fig5a_right <- genePlot(se_small, candidates, nrow = 1) + 
  labs(title = "Small dataset (n=16)") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(se_full)$anno_colors$Sex) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.1, 1.1)) + 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 10), axis.text = element_text(size = 8), plot.title = element_text(size = 14)) + 
  facet_wrap(~factor(feature, levels = candidates_order), nrow = 1)  # order panels by staged.FDR

df_small2$staged.FDR <- ifelse(is.na(df_small2$staged.FDR), 1, df_small2$staged.FDR)
fig5b_left <- volcano(df_small2, logFC = logFC, signif = staged.FDR, labels = show) +
  labs(x = "Sex:Stress Interaction logFC", tag = "B") + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-10, 10))

fig5b_right <- genePlot(se_small2, candidates, nrow = 1) + 
  labs(title = "Small dataset 2 (n=16)") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(se_full)$anno_colors$Sex) + 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 10), axis.text = element_text(size = 8), plot.title = element_text(size = 14)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.1, 1.1)) + 
  facet_wrap(~factor(feature, levels = candidates_order), nrow = 1)  # order panels by staged.FDR

df_full$staged.FDR <- ifelse(is.na(df_full$staged.FDR), 1, df_full$staged.FDR)
fig5c_left <- volcano(df_full, logFC = logFC, signif = staged.FDR, labels = show) +
  labs(x = "Sex:Stress Interaction logFC", tag = "C")

fig5c_right <- genePlot(se_full, candidates, nrow = 1) + 
  labs(title = "Full dataset (n=122)") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(se_full)$anno_colors$Sex) + 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 10), axis.text = element_text(size = 8), plot.title = element_text(size = 14)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.1, 1.1)) + 
  facet_wrap(~factor(feature, levels = candidates_order), nrow = 1)  # order panels by staged.FDR

legend <- plot_grid(get_legend(fig5a_left + theme(legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.text = element_text(size = 10))), get_legend(fig5a_right + theme(legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.text = element_text(size = 10))), nrow = 1)

fig5 <- plot_grid(
          plot_grid(
            plot_grid(fig5a_left + theme(legend.position = "none"), fig5a_right + theme(legend.position = "none"),
                      nrow = 1, labels = NA, rel_widths = c(1, 2)),
            plot_grid(fig5b_left + theme(legend.position = "none"), fig5b_right + theme(legend.position = "none"),
                      nrow = 1, labels = NA, rel_widths = c(1, 2)),
            plot_grid(fig5c_left + theme(legend.position = "none"), fig5c_right + theme(legend.position = "none"),
                      nrow = 1, labels = NA, rel_widths = c(1, 2)),
            nrow = 3), 
            legend, 
            ncol = 1, 
          rel_heights = c(1, 0.05))
fig5
cairo_pdf("./figures/fig5_small_dataset_confidence.pdf", width = 11, height = 10)
fig5
dev.off()
```
